item.title: Camp Brew: The seventeen thousand dollar summer camp
item.description:
The big business of bunks and bugs...
Attention campers: Lunch may be canceled due to lack of hustle, but this newsletter isn’t. As we enter the time of year when suddenly millions of kids (and some adults) are looking for stuff to do, we’re bringing you a special edition all about the business of summer camps. Read on to learn how they evolved from military-like drill camps to a billion-dollar industry that serves kids gourmet meals in between ceramics courses. Welcome to Camp Morning Brew.
https://www.morningbrew.com/issues/camp-brew

item.title: What Elon's worth: Elon Musk becomes the first trillionaire
item.description:
The world has its first trillionaire...
Let’s go. Sure, you’re not supposed to wear white to a wedding to avoid upstaging the bride, but what about blue and orange? Couples getting married tonight who likely booked their date over a year ago—and thought they had made their last tough call by opting for either a band or a DJ—are now facing the ultimate quandary: TV or no TV. For many, the Knicks and Spurs will be a last-minute addition to their matrimonial guest list as New York tries to clinch its first NBA Championship since 1973 in Game 5. One Spurs-loving bride told the WSJ that after her mom nixed her plan for a projector, she asked the DJ to announce the score throughout the reception: “But I am going to tell him: If we’re losing, or if we lose, maybe just don’t say anything.”

item.title: It’s just Field: Etsy witches and the energy price shock
item.description:
Inflation reached 4.2% in May…
Good day. What’s the only thing you need to complete a $100,000 wedding? For many brides, apparently, it’s a $14 “ Good Weather Spell ” from an Etsy witch. A Nerdwallet personal finance expert told Bloomberg, “Because the financial part of weddings feel so out of control, people are trying to do whatever they can to maintain control.” However, Etsy actually bans witches they catch selling supernatural spells on its platform, so it feels a bit risky.

item.description:
Big World Cup matches are still not sold out...
